properties.description: Community House is open every weekday from 9-5. Everybody is welcome to come in, take a seat in a warm space, and have a hot drink. We can also provide information, advice & guidance about anything you have which is worrying you - you can speak to one of our volunteers or staff about something on your mind, or we can connect you with local places which may be able to support you.
properties.title: Community House

properties.address: The Old Girls School Community Centre, SHERBURN-IN-ELMET, North Yorkshire LS25 6BL
properties.description: "Cuppa Connect" is a weekly drop-in session at The Old Girls' School Community Centre in Sherburn-in-Elmet held every Tuesdays between 1-3pm serving free hot drinks and cake to all attendees. The sessions are funded to ensure that there is no financial barrier for people to attend. Volunteers offer a friendly smile, like to chat and give warm welcome to all. We use the space as a forum to bring other organisations to Sherburn with a range of information, support and advice on offer residents. Digital inclusion volunteers are always on hand to support attendees as well as blood pressure checking being on offer.
properties.title: Cuppa Connect

properties.address: 36 Barwic Parade, Selby, North Yorkshire YO8 8DL
properties.description: SPACE OPENING ON 4th November 2026** The Selby Community Fridge is open every Wednesday afternoon, from 1-3pm at St Richard's Centre. The Fridge is a food waste project, collecting food which would have gone to waste from local supermarkets & businesses. This is then distributed for free to the community. Everybody is welcome to come and use the Fridge - there are no requirements and we don't ask any questions. The Fridge runs alongside a welcoming community cafe space where you can get a hot drink and chat to our friendly volunteers as you wait. We can provide information, advice & guidance if you have anything on your mind or need help with a particular issues you are facing. The Fridge will be re-opening on Wednesday 4th November.
properties.title: Selby Community Fridge

We look forward to welcoming you.
properties.title: Selby Library

properties.address: Sherburn & Villages Community Library, Sherburn in Elmet, North Yorkshire LS25 6EA
properties.description: Our community library is a natural place for people to meet up as it is a warm, welcoming safe space with comfy seats where people can read newspapers, magazines or books, work on jigsaws, play board games, take part in activites and events or just chat with other local people and volunteers. Hopefully you can make some new friends in the library too! We have once again secured funding to offer free hot drinks from November 2026 to March 2027. We also sell biscuits. Come along and make the most of our welcoming space. Check the Sherburn in Elmet events calendar for full details of what's going on. https://sherburninelmet.co.uk/events/

properties.description: The Atrium is a warm and friendly space, open from 10am-2pm on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday each week, during school term time. Come along to connect with other people and enjoy simple food and drink together, all free of charge. A quiet space is open throughout the day with reflective sessions at 10am, 12noon and 2pm. Crafts, games and activities, together with toys for toddlers and babies are available. There is limited parking at the Gateway Centre which is reserved for staff and those who are disabled. However, Morrisons is just across the road and you can park there free of charge.
